titles.title: Smaller Class Sizes for Students and Educators Act of 2026
Smaller Class Sizes for Students and Educators Act of 2026
A bill to provide grants to local educational agencies to help public schools reduce class size in the early elementary grades, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
